page.layout: One page of title text, centred. Above it is a block of inverted, mirrored lines, which is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. Below that: a woodcut, the word IESVS, a motto with its reference, the word TIGVRI, and the printer's line at the foot.

main_text.l: Ecce agnus Dei, qui tollit peccata mun-

page.notes: The woodcut, a figure with a lamb or similar scene, is not transcribed. The upper block (IN IOANNIS APO-/STOLI... / XXXVII / IN EIVSDEM APOSTOLI DVAS POSTERIORES EPISTOLAS... / AVTHORE RODOLPHO GVALTHERO TIGVRINO / motto in italic) appears mirrored and inverted, so it is show-through and left out. The printer's line and date are read from a faint scan and may contain errors. The motto's reference "Ioann. 1." is uncertain; the scan is faint.
